Mission Local reported that SFMTA board vice chair Gwyneth Borden was censured by the Ethics Commission for lobbying city staff and officials on behalf of Fiorella, which paid her $12,500 as a “consultant.” She sent dozens of emails seeking approval to legalize the restaurant’s outdoor deck. The commission considered raising her proposed $9,000 fine to the maximum $37,500. A follow-up reported that Borden resigned.
